newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - DeKalb EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DeKalb EPS view cut.

text.p: Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Friday she had cut her fiscal 1997 earnings estimate for DeKalb Genetics Corp to $1.70 a share from $1.75.

-- DeKalb today reported earnings for the fiscal third quarter of $0.73 a share, up from $0.51 a year ago. DeKalb beat the consensus estimate of $0.68 a share but did not reach Wittenburg's estimate of $0.80.
-- "This company has good short- and long-term earnings fundamentals," Wittenburg said, adding she continues to have a buy rating on the stock.
-- She estimated that DeKalb's share of the North American seed corn market rose to 11.5 percent this year from 11 percent a year ago.
-- DeKalb shares were up four points at 77-3/4.
